subject: Coord: VPC + IAM deep-dive — new time options & pre-reads
message_1_headers:
From: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@helixhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Sen <rajiv.sen@helixhealth.com>, procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: 2027-09-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Deep-dive request — VPC + IAM for Redwood Private deployment
message_1_body:
Hi Soojin and Ben,

Thanks for the excellent demo last week. Our infra and security teams would like a deeper technical session focused on VPC connectivity patterns, VPN vs DirectConnect options, and IAM controls for a Private deployment. Attendees will include myself (platform lead), Rajiv (network architect), and our procurement team to cover timelines and SLAs.

Can you propose 60–90 minute slots next week that include your SE and someone from security/compliance? We prefer mornings PT. Also, any pre-read that helps Rajiv prepare would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Alice
Platform Lead, HelixHealth
--
Alice Moreno
alice.moreno@helixhealth.com
message_2_headers:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@helixhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-19T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deep-dive request — VPC + IAM for Redwood Private deployment
message_2_body:
Hi Alice — great to hear Rajiv and procurement will join. Ben and I can lead the session; I’ll have Karthik (solutions engineer) run the network/IAM demo.

Proposed 90-minute blocks next week (all PT):
- Tues 9/21 09:30–11:00
- Wed 9/22 10:00–11:30
- Thu 9/23 08:30–10:00

We’ll prepare a short pre-read that covers: architecture overview, required firewall rules/ports, proxy/NAT patterns, sample IAM roles & recommended policies, and a short checklist for on-prem customers. I’ve attached a draft pre-read and a simple networking constraints diagram for Rajiv to review.

Can you confirm which time works and whether procurement prefers to be present for the whole session or join the last 20 minutes for SLAs/pricing?

Cheers,
Soojin
message_3_headers:
From: Rajiv Sen <rajiv.sen@helixhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@helixhealth.com>, procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: 2027-09-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deep-dive request — VPC + IAM for Redwood Private deployment
message_3_body:
Thanks — the pre-read looks useful. Quick notes from my side:
- We need details on routing for cross-region failover and how Redwood handles source IP preservation for audit logs.
- Our current firewall policy blocks outbound 8443; need to understand if that's required.
- Procurement will only need the final 20 minutes.

Wed 10:00–11:30 PT works best for engineering. Can you send a calendar invite with the agenda + any access instructions for our network diagrams (we'd like to share a topology during the call)?

—Rajiv
message_4_headers:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rajiv Sen <rajiv.sen@helixhealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@helixhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-19T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deep-dive request — VPC + IAM for Redwood Private deployment
message_4_body:
Great — I’ll put Wed 9/22 10:00–11:30 PT on the calendar and mark procurement for the last 20 minutes.

Agenda (draft):
1) Introductions & goals (5m)
2) VPC connectivity patterns + routing and cross-region notes (20m)
3) IAM model, key rotation, and audit considerations (20m)
4) Live run-through on a sample on-prem network (25m)
5) Procurement / next steps & SLA Qs (20m)

Soojin/Karthik — can you confirm who will cover IAM vs network during the live run-through? Also I’ll attach the Zoom link and include the pre-read we discussed.

Thanks,
Ben
message_5_headers:

message_5_body:
Quick update — procurement has a mandatory vendor-review slot that conflicts with Wed 9/22 10:00–10:30. Rajiv can keep the engineering portion but procurement asked to move their block to 11:10–11:30 PT or join a separate short call.

Options:
- Keep main session Wed 10:00–11:30 PT; procurement joins 11:10–11:30 (they’ll dial in late).
- Move the whole session to Thu 8:30–10:00 PT so procurement can fully attend.

I recommend keeping the Wed slot and letting procurement join late (fewer reschedule ripples). If everyone agrees I’ll update the invite and add explicit agenda times for procurement items.

Also attaching the final pre-read (redwood-vpc-qa-pre-read.pdf) and a lightweight network diagram (networking-constraints-diagram.png) in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/DEAL-4839/pre-read

Monica
Redwood Customer Success — Technical Onboarding
